videos.title: What Happens to Your Body After Stopping Ozempic
videos.point: 25-40% of Ozempic weight loss is muscle; after stopping, regained weight is mostly fat and muscle does not return, slowing metabolism.
content: GLP-1 acts on brain to cut hunger and slows digestion
Side effects persist: gastroparesis, vision/hair loss, deficiencies, pancreatitis
Counter with resistance training + leucine-rich animal protein
videos.watch_why: Concrete mechanism and percentage on muscle loss plus actionable protocol; not just side-effect list.

videos.title: Something is jamming GPS over Europe. Here's what we found
videos.point: GPS interference over Europe, Greenland, and Canada traced to a constellation of Russian early-warning satellites in Molniya orbits, including Cosmos 2546.
content: Research by Todd Humphreys and Zach Clements at UT Austin
Events documented 2019–2026; source narrowed via satellite tracking
Implications for aviation and loss of GPS resilience discussed
videos.watch_why: Clear mechanism identification with named researchers and satellite culprit; not just 'something is jamming'.

videos.title: Cast Iron Leaving Black Residue? It's Not Your Seasoning
videos.point: Black residue on cast iron is usually carbonized food or loose carbon, not a failed seasoning layer.
content: Caused by high heat carbonizing residue; fix by lowering heat
Clean with soap and sturdy brush rather than stripping
Most cases are normal carbon shedding during wipe-down
videos.watch_why: Direct mechanism and simple protocol that prevents unnecessary stripping; matches common shop question.

videos.title: IPCON PPA-CF vs PPA-GF: One Is the Strongest Filament I've Ever Tested
videos.point: IPCON PPA-CF shows higher bending strength and stiffness than PPA-GF in tensile, shear, impact, and print tests when printed slower than advertised speeds.
content: Compared brittleness, moisture, shrinkage, layer adhesion, creep
Horizontal prints and annealing effects tested
CF version edges GF in load-bearing metrics
videos.watch_why: Specific test numbers and material comparison useful for 3D print shop; full 22 min for all graphs.

videos.title: Electricity Does Not "Split" H₂O. And That's VERY Useful.
videos.point: Water electrolysis produces acid at the anode and base at the cathode via separate reactions, not a simple one-step H₂O split, which explains separated gas evolution.
content: Electron addition at cathode liberates H₂ and leaves OH⁻
Mixing chambers neutralizes the acid and base
Useful for understanding why gases bubble separately
videos.watch_why: Corrects common misconception with concrete electrode chemistry; high production value on mechanism.
